name: California State Duck Stamp Project grants

funder.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: Grants funded by State Duck Stamp sales for restoring, enhancing and creating California waterfowl wetland habitat, plus waterfowl research, awarded through an annual proposal solicitation.

steps: Administrative review for completeness and eligibility
Fish and Game Commission considers funding recommendations

eligibility.rule: Have waterfowl habitat enhancement, restoration, creation or research experience
Project is intended to benefit waterfowl directly
Project budget includes no more than 6% overhead

documents: Project location map for habitat proposals

deadline.quote: FY 2027 Proposal Solicitation Notice (PDF) released 11/23/2026 - Proposals due January 22, 2027, at 5:00 p.m.

applicant_types.quote: to nonprofit organizations, local government agencies, state departments and federal agencies

geography.quote: Identify activities which are needed for the conservation and maintenance of California's waterfowl habitat on public land

access.quote: annually solicits proposals in November or December of each year

window.quote: annually solicits proposals in November or December of each year

pool.quote: The Stamp Project has up to $1,135,000 that may be allocated for projects on a Fiscal Year (FY) basis.

co_finance_required.quote: Is the project cost shared (in-kind or money) and identified in the budget? Cost share cannot include overhead costs or NAWCA projects. Maximum 3 pts.

effort.quote: FY 2027 Proposal Solicitation Notice (PDF) released 11/23/2026 - Proposals due January 22, 2027, at 5:00 p.m.

will meet and review eligible project proposals and advise the Department
